name: Quilt Balloon Patchwork Sky
description: A hot air balloon made of patchwork quilt floating over a patchwork farmland at golden hour, with floating tea cups and saucers in the sky.
prompt: A hot air balloon stitched from colorful vintage patchwork quilts floating over a geometric patchwork farmland at golden hour, oversized porcelain tea cups and saucers drifting in the sky like clouds, soft warm light, nostalgic atmosphere, whimsical digital art, highly detailed, no text, no watermarks
caption: Drifting over a world stitched together by memories and tea. 🫖🎈🧵 Where does your patchwork heart want to float?
